Features you’ll love

Fall in love with the Ice Cream Maker Attachment

The KitchenAid Ice cream maker transforms your stand mixer into an ice cream machine. Create thick and creamy ice creams, sorbets and more from scratch.

Simply attach the frozen ice cream bowl to the base of your household KitchenAid® Stand Mixer* to quickly and easily make up to 1.9L of your favourite frozen treat.

The KitchenAid Ice Cream Maker was designed to ensure the bowl stays colder longer** for a consistent texture across recipes, and more scoopable ice cream out of the bowl.

*Sold separately, fits all Tilt-Head Stand Mixers (KSM45, KSM150, KSM160, KSM180, KSM192, KSM195), except the 3.3L Artisan Mini Stand Mixer KSM3311; and does fit selected Bowl-Lift Stand Mixers(KSM60, KSM70 and KSM7581), does not fit KSMC895 and KPM5. **Compared to previous model KICA0WH

Works with all KitchenAid tilt-head stand mixers
Easy to connect
Frozen treats in 30 minutes*
*Excluding prep time
Makes up to 1.9L of ice cream, gelatos & more
Bowl freeze time of 16 hours
Simple set up
Open bowl
To easily add ingredients

What's in the box

Want to know which accessories your new ice cream bowl includes? Here's a sneak peek of all the essentials that you'll receive!
1 x 1.9L ice cream bowl

Improved design ensures the bowl stays cooler, for longer* to ensure a thick and creamy texture.

*Compared to previous model KICA0wh

1 x dasher
For thorough ingredient incorporation rotates inside the bowl to spread, scrape and mix for even freezing.
1 x drive assembly
Re-designed to easily connect to the stand mixer.

I have owned this attachment for just over a month and have used it twice weekly since purchasing. It is so easy to use and within 20 minutes I have soft serve home made ice cream. It really is a fantastic invention.
